title: Blithe
summary: BLITHE, adjective [Latin loetus; Eng. glad. See Bliss and glad.] Gay; merry; joyous; sprightly; mirthful. For that fair female troop thou sawest, that seemed Of goddesses, so blithe so smooth, so gay.
